title: AGNT error
description: Every error, as application/problem+json: RFC 9457 problem details with code, retryable and details (PROTOCOL.md 9).

code.description: A stable code: PROTOCOL.md section 9 and CLIENT.md "Errors" list them.

retryable.description: True exactly for 429 and 5xx; act on Retry-After.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation in English, which may change.

resumeToken.description: For token_expired / history_migration only: explicit user/client acceptance is required before passing this opaque token as since. Never automatically replay it.
